detail.longDescription:
Calculator is a clean, easy-to-use calculator app for everyday math and more. It handles basic calculations and scientific functions when you need them and keeps a history of your past results so you can quickly go back and check or reuse them. With its classic design, it feels familiar and straightforward—perfect for quick sums at work, school, or home.

AVAILABLE FOR FREE
• Basic & Scientific Calculator
• Great Visibility; Big buttons for easy calculations
• Live Currency Converter; get exchange rate prices
• History Tape; Track all calculations, taxes, and expenses
• Equation edit function
• Calculate with Degrees or Radians
• Memory Banks
• Choose your Decimal Notation
• Set the Number of Decimals
• Available in 12 languages
• Made for iPad & iPhone
• Support Split View & Dark Mode

BASIC AND SCIENTIFIC
Rotate your device to access all scientific buttons. Or if you prefer calculating in portrait mode, simply swipe left.

YOUR EXPERIENCE IS IMPORTANT TO US!
As your experience is important to us, we’re happy with your feedback, questions, and suggestions. Please share any support as our team is always ready to help via support@impalastudios.com

Mathematical Operations
Addition, Subtraction, Division, Multiplication, Percentages, Square, Cubic Exponent, Nth Exponent, Square Root, Cubic Root, Nth Root, Engineering Exponent, Factorial, Power of Two, Power of Ten, Power of E, Natural Logarithm, Common Logarithm, Binary Logarithm, Sine, Cosine, Tangent, Arc Sine, Arc Cosine, Arc Tangent, Hyperbolic Sine, Hyperbolic Cosine, Hyperbolic Tangent, Hyperbolic ArcSine, Hyperbolic Arc Cosine, Hyperbolic ArcTangent, Multiplicative Inverse, Random Number Input

LOVING CALCULATOR?
